title: A/R Summary: buckets net invoices against credits, Total adds them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has a $100.00 invoice 10 days past due and an unused $30.00 credit memo created 5 days ago.
  • Customer X has a $50.00 invoice not yet due.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Find customer X.
  4. Read customer X's Current.
  5. Read customer X's 1-30 Days.
  6. Read customer X's Total.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • $50.00.

Step 5:

  • $70.00 (100 minus 30).

Step 6:

  • $120.00.

Why this matters: The summary figure is what the shop believes it is owed per customer.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Application/AccountReceivable/AgingSummary/AgingSummaryQueryHandler.php:26-45; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Domain/AccountReceivable/AgingBuckets.php:48-76. V1 code, quoted: `$buckets->add1to30($amount) ... $this->total = $this->total?->add($amount) ?? $amount;`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-051) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
